resources.string: Tap the orb, give the assistant a job, and get on with your day — it works on it in the background and tells you when it is done.

Lets your assistant open an app, read what is on the screen and tap or type for you — only while it is doing a task you asked for, like putting biryani in your Swiggy cart or filling a form with your details. A small bar with a Stop button shows whenever it is working. It never pays, moves money, types passwords, PINs or OTPs, or sends messages: at those steps it stops and hands the phone back to you. When no task is running it reads nothing.
